corrections.source:
The TNO Food Collaborative (run by The Neighbourhood Organization) provides free food access to thousands of individuals in the Thorncliffe Park and Flemingdon Park communities, including fresh produce, eggs, and dairy products distributed twice a month, with year-round distribution supported by community partners like Greenwin Cares.

Multi-service settlement agency serving Thorncliffe Park, Flemingdon Park, St. James Town and Taylor Massey. Services include settlement support (needs assessment, orientation to life in Canada/Ontario, citizenship preparation classes, immigration forms help), housing assistance (housing search, subsidized housing applications, rent bank access, energy bill assistance), seniors programs (Integrated Services for Seniors, personal support services), youth programs (e.g., after-school girls' programs), employment services, language training, and violence-against-women counselling. Free; call or drop in.

corrections.source: Midwifery clinic (East York/Don Mills) providing free, Ministry of Health-funded care through pregnancy, labour and birth, and for parent and baby through 6 weeks postpartum. Births are attended at home, the Toronto Birth Centre or Michael Garron Hospital; midwives are on call 24/7 for urgent concerns, and complications are referred to obstetricians, pediatricians and lactation consultants. Multilingual staff (English, Arabic, French, Spanish, Farsi, Dari and others) and prenatal classes including Newborn 101.

corrections.source: Free legal advice and representation for low-income people in the catchment area (Lake Ontario to York Mills/401, Yonge/Don River to Victoria Park Ave), in four areas: housing law (eviction prevention, illegal lockouts, tenant rights), employment law (employment standards, wrongful dismissal, severance, EI), immigration law (PR applications, work permits, citizenship) and income supports (ODSP, OW, CPP, OAS, GIS, Canada Disability Benefit); also public legal education and limited document services (affidavits, notarial true copies). Intake Line: 416-441-1764 ext. 1, Mon–Thu 9:00 AM–12:30 PM (voicemail with 1–3 business day callback; no walk-ins; in-person intake by booked appointment Mon/Wed 1:30–4:30 PM).

corrections.source: Roman Catholic parish at 16 Thorncliffe Park Drive offering regular Mass, sacraments and parish events. Connects families to summer camp opportunities for children and youth offered across parishes of the Archdiocese of Toronto.
corrections.text: د رومن کاتولیک کلیسا (Roman Catholic parish) په 16 Thorncliffe Park Drive کې موقعیت لري چې منظم عبادتونه (Mass)، مذهبي مراسم (sacraments) او د کلیسا پروګرامونه ترسره کوي. دا د کورنیو د ماشومانو او ځوانانو لپاره د اوړي کمپونو (summer camps) فرصتونه چې د Archdiocese of Toronto په بېلابېلو کلیساګانو کې شتون لري، سره یې تړي.
corrections.note: garbled Mass/parish events/summer camps fixed; Urdu ہ removed; address and archdiocese in English; terms: church, children, youth; unsourced phrasing: summer camps = 'د اوړي کمپونه' + English

corrections.source: 911 emergency response: fire suppression, rescue, and medical first response. Call 911 in an emergency.
corrections.text: 911 بیړنی ځواب: د اور وژل، ژغورنه او لومړنۍ طبي مرسته. په بیړني حالت کې 911 ته زنګ ووهئ.
corrections.note: 'prevent setting fires' -> fire suppression (اور وژل); اضطراري -> بیړنی; terms: emergency (situation), emergency services, firefighters (اور وژل root)

corrections.source: Emergency food support for families in need (free food distribution twice monthly). No shelter, cooling centre, or crisis-line services specific to the Food Collaborative were confirmed. Offers crisis intervention and counselling through its violence-against-women program; acts as a Toronto Rent Bank Access Centre and Emergency Energy Fund call centre (416-397-7368).
corrections.text: د اړتیا لرونکو کورنیو لپاره بیړنۍ خوراکي مرسته (په میاشت کې دوه ځله وړیا خوراکي توکي ویشل کیږي). د خوراکي همکارۍ (Food Collaborative) لپاره هیڅ ډول سرپناه، ایرکانډیشن لرونکی ځای (cooling centre) یا د بحران ټیلیفوني کرښې خدمتونه تایید شوي ندي. د ښځو پر وړاندې تاوتریخوالي د خپل پروګرام له لارې د بحران پر مهال مرسته (crisis intervention) او مشوره چمتو کوي؛ د Toronto Rent Bank (د کرایې بانک) د لاسرسي مرکز او د Emergency Energy Fund (د انرژۍ بیړني فنډ) د تلیفون مرکز په توګه کار کوي (416-397-7368).
corrections.note: 'every two days' -> twice a month; 'house tax bank' -> Rent Bank; removed inserted 'world'; garbled cooling centre fixed; terms: emergency, food assistance, twice a month (low), shelter, helpline/crisis line, violence against women, rent; unsourced phrasing: cooling space/centre = 'ایرکانډیشن لرونکی ځای' (air-conditioned place) + English; unsourced phrasing: crisis intervention = 'د بحران پر مهال مرسته' + English

corrections.source: City-run community/recreation centre at 29 St Dennis Dr with an indoor pool (swim lessons, leisure swims), fitness facilities, and a library branch, offering registered recreation programs.
corrections.text: د ښار لخوا اداره شوی ټولنیز/تفریحی مرکز په 29 St Dennis Dr کې موقعیت لري چې د دننه لامبو حوض (indoor pool) (د لامبو زده کړه او تفریحي لامبو وهل)، د فټنس اسانتیاوو او د کتابتونو یو شاخه لري او د نوم لیکنې تفریحی پروګرامونه وړاندې کوي.
corrections.note: 'indoor burner' -> indoor pool; 'passing' -> swimming lessons/leisure swims; address in English; terms: swimming, library; unsourced phrasing: pool = 'لامبو حوض' + English

corrections.source: The Leaside Towers Tenants Association page for 85 & 95 Thorncliffe Park Drive functions as a contact directory for residents: property manager (Morguard) at 416-421-8109 and building security guards (Building 85: 647-462-0404; Building 95: 416-906-7970).
corrections.text: د لیساید تاورز (Leaside Towers) د کرایه دارانو ټولنې (Tenants Association) پاڼه د 85 او 95 Thorncliffe Park Drive لپاره د اوسیدونکو د اړیکو لارښود په توګه کار کوي: د ملکیت مدیر (Morguard) په شمیره 416-421-8109 او د ودانۍ محافظین (ودانۍ 85: 647-462-0404؛ ودانۍ 95: 416-906-7970).
corrections.note: 'host people's association' -> tenants association; terms: tenant

corrections.source: Midwives are on call 24/7 for urgent pregnancy and labour concerns; no separate emergency program is listed.
corrections.text: قابلې د امیندوارۍ او زېږون د بیړنیو اندېښنو لپاره د ورځې 24 ساعته، په اونۍ کې اووه ورځې د تلیفون له لارې چمتو دي؛ هیڅ جلا بیړنی پروګرام نه دی لیست شوی.
corrections.note: garbled first clause rewritten so midwives are on call 24/7; Dari حامله گی removed; terms: midwife, pregnancy, maternity care, 24/7, emergency

corrections.source: Grassroots non-profit (founded 2018 by parents of children with autism, incorporated 2020) providing free, community-based, family-oriented services for children and youth with autism and other neurodevelopmental disorders in East York. Programs include Roots youth programs running Monday to Saturday, weekend respite, monthly parent support meetings, after-school homework support, free inclusive summer and March break camps, back-to-school events, educational workshops and autism/disability awareness campaigns.
corrections.text: د خلکو په کچه یو غیرانتفاعي سازمان (چې په 2018 کال کې د اتیزم سره مخ شوي ماشومانو د والدینو لخوا تاسیس شو او په 2020 کال کې رسمي ثبت شول) چې په East York کې د اتیزم او نور عصبي-دماغي اختلالات سره مخ شوي ماشومان او ځوانانو ته وړیا، د ټولنې پر بنسټ او د کورنۍ په پام کې نیولو سره خدمات چمتو کوي. دغه پروګرامونه د ځوانانو د "Roots" پروګرامونه شامل دي چې له دوشنبه تر شنبې پورې ترسره کیږي، د اونۍ پای د آرامۍ او استراحت لپاره خدمات، د والدینو میاشتنی ملګري ملاتړ غونډې، د ښوونځي وروسته د کورنۍ دندې (homework) سره مرسته، وړیا او شامله د اوړي او مارچ رخصتي په ورځو ترسره شوې کمپونه، د ښوونځي بیا پیل په برخه کې پروګرامونه، زده کړې ورکشاپونه او د اتیزم/معلولیت په اړه د پوهاوی کمپاینونه دي.
corrections.note: 'sudden conditions' -> disability; garbled East York and homework fixed; terms: disability, homework, after-school programs

corrections.source: The hub's page features an 'In crisis? Click here' link and lists local crisis supports: Kids Help Phone 1-800-668-6868, Talk Suicide Canada 1-833-456-4566, Distress Centres of Greater Toronto 416-408-4357, Gerstein Crisis Centre 416-929-5200, Anishnawbe Health Toronto Mental Health Crisis Management Service 1-855-242-3310, Naseeha Mental Health Hotline 1-866-627-3342, Youthdale Treatment Centres Crisis & Mobile Support Team 416-363-9990, Scarborough Health Network Community Crisis Line 416-495-2891, Assaulted Women's Helpline 416-863-0511, Toronto Rape Crisis Centre 416-597-8808, and Michael Garron Hospital Emergency Department (825 Coxwell Ave.). Designated cooling space: provides air-conditioned indoor relief during extreme heat warnings/alerts.
corrections.text: د هاب پاڼه د "آیا تاسو په بحران کې یاست؟ دلته کلیک وکړئ" لینک لري او د سیمه ایز بحران مرستو لیست یې شامل دی: Kids Help Phone 1-800-668-6868، Talk Suicide Canada 1-833-456-4566، Distress Centres of Greater Toronto 416-408-4357، Gerstein Crisis Centre 416-929-5200، Anishnawbe Health Toronto Mental Health Crisis Management Service 1-855-242-3310، Naseeha Mental Health Hotline 1-866-627-3342، Youthdale Treatment Centres Crisis & Mobile Support Team 416-363-9990، Scarborough Health Network Community Crisis Line 416-495-2891، Assaulted Women's Helpline 416-863-0511، Toronto Rape Crisis Centre 416-597-8808، او Michael Garron Hospital Emergency Department (د روغتون بیړنۍ خونه) (825 Coxwell Ave.). ټاکل شوی ایرکانډیشن لرونکی ځای (cooling space): د سختې ګرمۍ د خبرتیاوو (extreme heat warnings/alerts) پر مهال د ودانۍ دننه ایرکانډیشن لرونکی ځای چمتو کوي.
corrections.note: hospital department name kept in English with Pashto gloss; cooling space was 'site (tomb/mausoleum)' -> air-conditioned place; terms: emergency department, extreme heat, air-conditioned, crisis; unsourced phrasing: cooling space/centre = 'ایرکانډیشن لرونکی ځای' (air-conditioned place) + English; unsourced phrasing: heat warnings kept in English after 'د سختې ګرمۍ د خبرتیاوو'
